title: Twisted automorphic descent to odd GSpin groups and applications
summary: We establish twisted automorphic descent from $(\mathrm{GL}_{2n}, \mathrm{GSpin}_2^δ)$, where $\mathrm{GSpin}_2^δ$ is anisotropic, to the odd $\mathrm{GSpin}$ group $\mathrm{GSpin}^{δ,α}_{2n+1}$, which may be split or non-split, generalizing a construction of Jiang--Liu--Xu--Zhang. As an application, we give a new explicit construction of the global Jacquet--Langlands correspondence between $\mathrm{GL}_2$ and $D^\times$, where $D$ is a quaternion division algebra over a number field.
